verdict.rationale: Evidence mentions compliance controls and audit-ready evidence 'in every pipeline' and security findings surfaced in merge requests, which loosely imply gating logic, but there is no explicit documentation of configurable merge request approval rules, required reviewers, code owners, or required-status-check enforcement. missing for 10: explicit docs on merge request approval rules/required approvers, branch protection push rules, required pipeline success before merge, code owners enforcement.
